claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, (-)-S-BAY K 8644 acts as a dihydropyridine L-type calcium channel agonist that at higher concentrations also behaves as a weak channel antagonist/relaxant, but this pharmacology is unlikely to produce meaningful cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen; killing is expected to be largely absent or weak/nonspecific.
